Game Overview

At its heart, Kill the zombies is a pixel game about face relentless hordes in epic, pixelated battles, where survival hinges on precise movements and swift kills. Each victory grants vital life boosts, as nightfall escalates the undead threat. Last through the night and live to fight another challenging day in this addictive test of endurance and skill.
